chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from someone else, from Al-Khashaab, from Ghiyath ibn Kalloob, from Is'haq ibn 'Ammar, from Abu 'Abdillah (peace be upon him)
that the Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) would, when he complained of his head, sniff the oil of Al-Juljulân, and it is sesame.

key_terms.الْجُلْجُلَانِ: Al-Juljulân (a specific term for sesame oil)

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad use to treat headaches according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* highlights the prophetic practice of using sesame oil (*Al-Juljulân*) for nasal inhalation to alleviate headaches, reflecting the broader Islamic tradition of utilizing natural remedies for health. In Shia scholarly tradition, this narration underscores the integration of spiritual and physical well-being, validating the use of common substances for medicinal purposes as part of the Sunnah. The identification of *Al-Juljulân* specifically as sesame oil provides clarity for jurists and practitioners regarding the specific type of oil recommended in this context.
